problem_sources.text: Overview: Step into a software development hackathon built to turn coding skill into bold solutions. About the Opportunity: Technorazz 2026 is an offline coding challenge by Jaipur National University (JNU), Jaipur, designed for participants interested in software development and hackathons. Working in teams, participants can take on a focused coding experience that puts their technical thinking into action. This opportunity offers a platform to showcase teamwork and collaboration, data structures and algorithms, problem solving, and critical thinking. Bring your ideas, sharpen your approach, and make your mark in an online software development challenge. Register for Technorazz 2026 and take on the challenge with your team in this offline hackathon by Jaipur National University (JNU), Jaipur. Eligibility: Open to students, professionals, and independent developers. Participants from any college, university, or organisation are eligible. Participants must be 18 years or older at the time of registration. Teams may consist of 4 members (minimum 3 and maximum 4). Domain: Cybersecurity and Blockchain Smart Education Clean and Green Energy MedTech and HealthTech Agriculture & Food Tech Transportation and Logistics Rules: The problem statement will be provided during the hackathon. Teams must select a problem statement from their chosen domain and develop it during the 10-hour development sprint. Registration Fee: ₹500 per team (pay on the registration form). Each team must consist of a maximum of 4 participants. Each team must select one domain from the six officially listed domains and develop their solution within that domain. Teams must submit their completed solution within the deadline specified by the organizing committee. Late submissions may not be considered. All submitted solutions must be original and developed during the hackathon. Pre-existing or ready-made projects are strictly prohibited. AI and Generative AI tools may be used as development assistance, subject to the instructions of the organizing committee. Teams must understand their implementation and be able to explain their use of AI during evaluation. The final solution must be software-based and may be developed as a web application, mobile application, or desktop application. Hardware-based prototypes will not be evaluated as part of the hackathon submission. Participants must bring their own laptops, chargers, and other required accessories. Teams must have the appropriate rights or permissions to use all code, images, datasets, APIs, media, and other assets included in their project. Organized By: Tech Orbit - Coding Club of Jaipur National University For Payment use this link: Pay here Prize Pool: The prize pool will be based on the quality, innovation, and advancement of the ideas presented by the participating teams. Teams presenting exceptionally innovative, impactful, and advanced-level solutions will have the opportunity to receive prizes and recognition directly through industry partners, rather than from the university. This approach is designed to provide deserving teams with industry-level recognition, opportunities, and rewards based on the potential of their ideas and solutions.

raw.details:
Overview:

Step into a software development hackathon built to turn coding skill into bold solutions.

About the Opportunity:

Technorazz 2026 is an offline coding challenge by Jaipur National University (JNU), Jaipur, designed for participants interested in software development and hackathons. Working in teams, participants can take on a focused coding experience that puts their technical thinking into action.

This opportunity offers a platform to showcase teamwork and collaboration, data structures and algorithms, problem solving, and critical thinking. Bring your ideas, sharpen your approach, and make your mark in an online software development challenge.

Register for Technorazz 2026 and take on the challenge with your team in this offline hackathon by Jaipur National University (JNU), Jaipur.

Eligibility:

  • Open to students, professionals, and independent developers.
  • Participants from any college, university, or organisation are eligible.
  • Participants must be 18 years or older at the time of registration.
  • Teams may consist of 4 members (minimum 3 and maximum 4).

Domain:

  • Cybersecurity and Blockchain
  • Smart Education
  • Clean and Green Energy
  • MedTech and HealthTech
  • Agriculture & Food Tech
  • Transportation and Logistics

Rules:

  • The problem statement will be provided during the hackathon. Teams must select a problem statement from their chosen domain and develop it during the 10-hour development sprint.
  • Registration Fee: ₹500 per team (pay on the registration form).
  • Each team must consist of a maximum of 4 participants.
  • Each team must select one domain from the six officially listed domains and develop their solution within that domain.
  • Teams must submit their completed solution within the deadline specified by the organizing committee. Late submissions may not be considered.
  • All submitted solutions must be original and developed during the hackathon. Pre-existing or ready-made projects are strictly prohibited.
  • AI and Generative AI tools may be used as development assistance, subject to the instructions of the organizing committee. Teams must understand their implementation and be able to explain their use of AI during evaluation.
  • The final solution must be software-based and may be developed as a web application, mobile application, or desktop application.
  • Hardware-based prototypes will not be evaluated as part of the hackathon submission.
  • Participants must bring their own laptops, chargers, and other required accessories.
  • Teams must have the appropriate rights or permissions to use all code, images, datasets, APIs, media, and other assets included in their project.

Organized By:

Tech Orbit - Coding Club of Jaipur National University

For Payment use this link:

Pay here

Prize Pool:

The prize pool will be based on the quality, innovation, and advancement of the ideas presented by the participating teams.

Teams presenting exceptionally innovative, impactful, and advanced-level solutions will have the opportunity to receive prizes and recognition directly through industry partners, rather than from the university.

This approach is designed to provide deserving teams with industry-level recognition, opportunities, and rewards based on the potential of their ideas and solutions.
